title: China Taste Map
synopsis: China has a famous saying, “South-sweet, north-salty, west-sour, and east-hot”. Taste authentic delicacies and embark on an incredible culinary journey through China!

fullText.simplified:
中国口味地图

    很多人都爱吃中国菜，但是哪种中国菜最好吃？这个是一个很难回答的问题，因为中国菜太多了。每个地方的中国菜都不太一样，都有自己的口味。总的来说，是“南甜北咸，西酸东辣”。
    “南甜”，意思是南方菜口味比较甜。这里的“南”主要是说上海、江苏和浙江这些地方，常用新鲜的鱼、蔬菜。这是外国人最容易习惯的口味。如果你还没吃过中国菜，可以从南方菜开始，江苏的叫花鸡就是个不错的选择。
    “北咸”，意思是北方菜口味有点咸。这里的“北”主要是说河北、北京这些地方，也可以是中国东北。因为这些地方的菜大部分都会用很多油，所以看起来很漂亮，吃起来很香。如果你喜欢口味咸一点儿的菜，可以试试北方菜，北京的北京烤鸭就很不错。
    “西酸”，意思是住在中国西边的人喜欢吃酸味。这里的“西”主要是说山西、陕西这些地方，这些地方的人常吃面条，面条里常常会放醋。这儿的菜看起来有点辣，但吃起来酸酸的，所以其实没那么辣，biangbiang面就是这样的。如果你也喜欢吃鱼，那你还可以试试酸菜鱼。
    “东辣”，意思是住在中国东边的人喜欢吃辣味，这里的“东”主要是说山东。这个说法其实不太对，因为现在山东人吃的菜都不太辣。有这个说法是因为，以前别的地方菜都不辣，只有山东菜有点儿辣，所以大家就觉得山东菜很辣，慢慢就有了“东辣”的说法。如果你不能吃辣，山东菜其实是可以吃的。如果你想吃辣的菜，试试四川菜，从宫保鸡丁开始。
    说了这么多，还是有很多地方没说到，东北有甜辣口味、西北有羊肉、西南有酸辣口味、东南有鱼。“南甜北咸，西酸东辣”的里的东、西、南、北也有不同的说法，我们现在用的也只是这里面最有名的说法。中国真是太大了，想吃完中国菜是一件很难的事情，但一定很有意思。
fullText.traditional:
中國口味地圖

    很多人都愛吃中國菜，但是哪種中國菜最好吃？這個是一個很難回答的問題，因為中國菜太多了。每個地方的中國菜都不太一樣，都有自己的口味。總的來說，是“南甜北鹹，西酸東辣”。
    “南甜”，意思是南方菜口味比較甜。這裡的“南”主要是說上海、江蘇和浙江這些地方，常用新鮮的魚、蔬菜。這是外國人最容易習慣的口味。如果你還沒吃過中國菜，可以從南方菜開始，江蘇的叫花雞就是個不錯的選擇。
    “北鹹”，意思是北方菜口味有點鹹。這裡的“北”主要是說河北、北京這些地方，也可以是中國東北。因為這些地方的菜大部分都會用很多油，所以看起來很漂亮，吃起來很香。如果你喜歡口味鹹一點兒的菜，可以試試北方菜，北京的北京烤鴨就很不錯。
    “西酸”，意思是住在中國西邊的人喜歡吃酸味。這裡的“西”主要是說山西、陝西這些地方，這些地方的人常吃麵條，麵條裡常常會放醋。這兒的菜看起來有點辣，但吃起來酸酸的，所以其實沒那麼辣，biangbiang麵就是這樣的。如果你也喜歡吃魚，那你還可以試試酸菜魚。
    “東辣”，意思是住在中國東邊的人喜歡吃辣味，這裡的“東”主要是說山東。這個說法其實不太對，因為現在山東人吃的菜都不太辣。有這個說法是因為，以前別的地方菜都不辣，只有山東菜有點兒辣，所以大家就覺得山東菜很辣，慢慢就有了“東辣”的說法。如果你不能吃辣，山東菜其實是可以吃的。如果你想吃辣的菜，試試四川菜，從宮保雞丁開始。
    說了這麼多，還是有很多地方沒說到，東北有甜辣口味、西北有羊肉、西南有酸辣口味、東南有魚。“南甜北鹹，西酸東辣”的裡的東、西、南、北也有不同的說法，我們現在用的也只是這裡面最有名的說法。中國真是太大了，想吃完中國菜是一件很難的事情，但一定很有意思。

sentences.traditional: 這個是一個很難回答的問題，因為中國菜太多了。

sentences.english: Many people love to eat Chinese food, but which Chinese food is the best?

sentences.simplified: 每个地方的中国菜都不太一样，都有自己的口味。
sentences.traditional: 每個地方的中國菜都不太一樣，都有自己的口味。
sentences.pinyin: měi ge dì fang de zhōng guó cài dōu bú tài yí yàng dōu yǒu zì jǐ de kǒu wèi
sentences.english: This is a difficult question to answer because there are so many Chinese dishes.

sentences.simplified: 总的来说，是“南甜北咸，西酸东辣”。
sentences.traditional: 總的來說，是“南甜北鹹，西酸東辣”。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng de lái shuō shì nán tián běi xián xī suān dōng là
sentences.english: The Chinese food in each place is not quite the same, and each place has its own flavors.
In general, it’s “South-sweet, north-salty, west-sour, and east-hot.”

sentences.simplified: “南甜”，意思是南方菜口味比较甜。
sentences.traditional: “南甜”，意思是南方菜口味比較甜。
sentences.pinyin: nán tián yì si shì nán fāng cài kǒu wèi bǐ jiào tián

sentences.simplified: 这里的“南”主要是说上海、江苏和浙江这些地方，常用新鲜的鱼、蔬菜。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的“南”主要是說上海、江蘇和浙江這些地方，常用新鮮的魚、蔬菜。
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ de nán zhǔ yào shì shuō shàng hǎi jiāng sū hé zhè jiāng zhè xiē dì fang cháng yòng xīn xiān de yú shū cài
sentences.english: “South-sweet” means that southern dishes taste sweeter.

sentences.simplified: 这是外国人最容易习惯的口味。
sentences.traditional: 這是外國人最容易習慣的口味。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì wài guó rén zuì róng yì xí guàn de kǒu wèi
sentences.english: The “south” here mainly refers to places such as Shanghai, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang, where fresh fish and vegetables are often used.

sentences.simplified: 如果你还没吃过中国菜，可以从南方菜开始，江苏的叫花鸡就是个不错的选择。
sentences.traditional: 如果你還沒吃過中國菜，可以從南方菜開始，江蘇的叫花雞就是個不錯的選擇。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ hái méi chī guò zhōng guó cài kě yǐ cóng nán fāng cài kāi shǐ jiāng sū de jiào huā jī jiù shì ge bú cuò de xuǎn zé
sentences.english: This is the taste that foreigners are most easily accustomed to.
If you haven’t eaten Chinese food before, you can start with southern dishes. “Beggar’s chicken” from Jiangsu is a good choice.

sentences.simplified: “北咸”，意思是北方菜口味有点咸。
sentences.traditional: “北鹹”，意思是北方菜口味有點鹹。

sentences.simplified: 这里的“北”主要是说河北、北京这些地方，也可以是中国东北。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的“北”主要是說河北、北京這些地方，也可以是中國東北。
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ de běi zhǔ yào shì shuō hé běi běi jīng zhè xiē dì fang yě kě yǐ shì zhōng guó dōng běi
sentences.english: “North-salty” means that northern dishes taste a little salty.

sentences.simplified: 因为这些地方的菜大部分都会用很多油，所以看起来很漂亮，吃起来很香。
sentences.traditional: 因為這些地方的菜大部分都會用很多油，所以看起來很漂亮，吃起來很香。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zhè xiē dì fang de cài dà bù fen dōu huì yòng hěn duō yóu suǒ yǐ kàn qǐ lái hěn piào liang chī qǐ lái hěn xiāng
sentences.english: The “north” here mainly refers to places such as Hebei and Beijing, but it can also be the northeast of China.

sentences.simplified: 如果你喜欢口味咸一点儿的菜，可以试试北方菜，北京的北京烤鸭就很不错。
sentences.traditional: 如果你喜歡口味鹹一點兒的菜，可以試試北方菜，北京的北京烤鴨就很不錯。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ xǐ huan kǒu wèi xián yì diǎn'r de cài kě yǐ shì shi běi fāng cài běi jīng de běi jīng kǎo yā jiù hěn bú cuò
sentences.english: Because most of the dishes in these places use a lot of oil, they look beautiful and taste delicious.
If you like salty dishes, you can try northern dishes. Peking duck from Beijing is very good.

sentences.simplified: “西酸”，意思是住在中国西边的人喜欢吃酸味。
sentences.traditional: “西酸”，意思是住在中國西邊的人喜歡吃酸味。
sentences.pinyin: xī suān yì si shì zhù zài zhōng guó xī biān de rén xǐ huan chī suān wèi

sentences.simplified: 这里的“西”主要是说山西、陕西这些地方，
sentences.traditional: 這裡的“西”主要是說山西、陝西這些地方，
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ de xī zhǔ yào shì shuō shān xī shǎn xī zhè xiē dì fang
sentences.english: “West-sour” means that people who live in the west of China like to eat sour food.

sentences.simplified: 这些地方的人常吃面条，面条里常常会放醋。
sentences.traditional: 這些地方的人常吃麵條，麵條裡常常會放醋。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē dì fang de rén cháng chī miàn tiáo miàn tiáo lǐ cháng cháng huì fàng cù
sentences.english: The “west” here mainly refers to places such as Shanxi and Shaanxi.

sentences.simplified: 这儿的菜看起来有点辣，但吃起来酸酸的，所以其实没那么辣，biangbiang面就是这样的。
sentences.traditional: 這兒的菜看起來有點辣，但吃起來酸酸的，所以其實沒那麼辣，biangbiang麵就是這樣的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè‘r de cài kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn là dàn chī qǐ lái suān suān de suǒ yǐ qí shí méi nà me là 2 miàn jiù shì zhè yàng de
sentences.english: People in these regions often eat noodles, and vinegar is commonly added to the noodles.

sentences.simplified: 如果你也喜欢吃鱼，那你还可以试试酸菜鱼。
sentences.traditional: 如果你也喜歡吃魚，那你還可以試試酸菜魚。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ yě xǐ huan chī yú nà nǐ hái kě yǐ shì shi suān cài yú
sentences.english: The dishes here look a little spicy, but they taste sour, so they’re not really that spicy. Biangbiang noodles are like this.
If you also like fish, then you can try hot and sour fish as well.

sentences.simplified: “东辣”，意思是住在中国东边的人喜欢吃辣味，
sentences.traditional: “東辣”，意思是住在中國東邊的人喜歡吃辣味，
sentences.pinyin: dōng là yì si shì zhù zài zhōng guó dōng bian de rén xǐ huan chī là wèi

sentences.simplified: 这里的“东”主要是说山东。
sentences.traditional: 這裡的“東”主要是說山東。
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ de dōng zhǔ yào shì shuō shān dōng
sentences.english: “East-hot” means that people living in the east of China like to eat spicy food.

sentences.simplified: 这个说法其实不太对，因为现在山东人吃的菜都不太辣。
sentences.traditional: 這個說法其實不太對，因為現在山東人吃的菜都不太辣。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shuō fa qí shí bú tài duì yīn wèi xiàn zài shān dōng rén chī de cài dōu bú tài là
sentences.english: The “east” here mainly refers to Shandong.

sentences.simplified: 有这个说法是因为，以前别的地方菜都不辣，只有山东菜有点儿辣，
sentences.traditional: 有這個說法是因為，以前別的地方菜都不辣，只有山東菜有點兒辣，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu zhè ge shuō fa shì yīn wèi yǐ qián bié de dì fang cài dōu bú là zhǐ yǒu shān dōng cài yǒu diǎn'r là
sentences.english: This saying is actually not that accurate because the dishes that people in Shandong eat nowadays are not that spicy.

sentences.simplified: 所以大家就觉得山东菜很辣，慢慢就有了“东辣”的说法。
sentences.traditional: 所以大家就覺得山東菜很辣，慢慢就有了“東辣”的說法。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ dà jiā jiù jué de shān dōng cài hěn là màn man jiù yǒu le dōng là de shuō fa
sentences.english: This saying is because, in the past, dishes from other regions were not spicy, and only dishes from Shandong were a little spicy.

sentences.simplified: 如果你不能吃辣，山东菜其实是可以吃的。
sentences.traditional: 如果你不能吃辣，山東菜其實是可以吃的。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ bù néng chī là shān dōng cài qí shí shì kě yǐ chī de
sentences.english: So people thought that Shandong dishes were very spicy, and slowly the “east-hot” saying came to be.

sentences.simplified: 如果你想吃辣的菜，试试四川菜，从宫保鸡丁开始。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想吃辣的菜，試試四川菜，從宮保雞丁開始。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng chī là de cài shì shi sì chuān cài cóng gōng bǎo jī dīng kāi shǐ
sentences.english: If you cannot tolerate spicy food, you can still enjoy Shandong cuisine.
If you want spicy food, try Sichuan cuisine, starting with Kung Pao chicken.

sentences.simplified: 说了这么多，还是有很多地方没说到，
sentences.traditional: 說了這麼多，還是有很多地方沒說到，
sentences.pinyin: shuō le zhè me duō hái shi yǒu hěn duō dì fang méi shuō dào

sentences.simplified: 东北有甜辣口味、西北有羊肉、西南有酸辣口味、东南有鱼。
sentences.traditional: 東北有甜辣口味、西北有羊肉、西南有酸辣口味、東南有魚。
sentences.pinyin: dōng běi yǒu tián là kǒu wèi xī běi yǒu yáng ròu xī nán yǒu suān là kǒu wèi dōng nán yǒu yú
sentences.english: Having said that, there are still many places that have not been mentioned.

sentences.traditional: “南甜北鹹，西酸東辣”的裡的東、西、南、北也有不同的說法，
sentences.pinyin: nán tián běi xián xī suān dōng là de lǐ de dōng xī nán běi yě yǒu bù tóng de shuō fa
sentences.english: The northeast has sweet and spicy flavors, the northwest has lamb, the southwest has hot and sour flavors, and the southeast has fish.

sentences.simplified: 我们现在用的也只是这里面最有名的说法。
sentences.traditional: 我們現在用的也只是這裡面最有名的說法。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men xiàn zài yòng de yě zhǐ shì zhè lǐ miàn zuì yǒu míng de shuō fa
sentences.english: There are different ways of describing east, west, north, and south in “South-sweet, north-salty, west-sour, and east-hot.”

sentences.simplified: 中国真是太大了，想吃完中国菜是一件很难的事情，但一定很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 中國真是太大了，想吃完中國菜是一件很難的事情，但一定很有意思。

sentences.english: The way we are using here is only the most famous one.

sentence_translations: China Taste Map
Many people love to eat Chinese food, but which Chinese food is the best?
This is a difficult question to answer because there are so many Chinese dishes.
The Chinese food in each place is not quite the same, and each place has its own flavors.
In general, it’s “South-sweet, north-salty, west-sour, and east-hot.”
“South-sweet” means that southern dishes taste sweeter.
The “south” here mainly refers to places such as Shanghai, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang, where fresh fish and vegetables are often used.
This is the taste that foreigners are most easily accustomed to.
If you haven’t eaten Chinese food before, you can start with southern dishes. “Beggar’s chicken” from Jiangsu is a good choice.
“North-salty” means that northern dishes taste a little salty.
The “north” here mainly refers to places such as Hebei and Beijing, but it can also be the northeast of China.
Because most of the dishes in these places use a lot of oil, they look beautiful and taste delicious.
If you like salty dishes, you can try northern dishes. Peking duck from Beijing is very good.
“West-sour” means that people who live in the west of China like to eat sour food.
The “west” here mainly refers to places such as Shanxi and Shaanxi.
People in these regions often eat noodles, and vinegar is commonly added to the noodles.
The dishes here look a little spicy, but they taste sour, so they’re not really that spicy. Biangbiang noodles are like this.
If you also like fish, then you can try hot and sour fish as well.
“East-hot” means that people living in the east of China like to eat spicy food.
The “east” here mainly refers to Shandong.
This saying is actually not that accurate because the dishes that people in Shandong eat nowadays are not that spicy.
This saying is because, in the past, dishes from other regions were not spicy, and only dishes from Shandong were a little spicy.
So people thought that Shandong dishes were very spicy, and slowly the “east-hot” saying came to be.
If you cannot tolerate spicy food, you can still enjoy Shandong cuisine.
If you want spicy food, try Sichuan cuisine, starting with Kung Pao chicken.
Having said that, there are still many places that have not been mentioned.
The northeast has sweet and spicy flavors, the northwest has lamb, the southwest has hot and sour flavors, and the southeast has fish.
There are different ways of describing east, west, north, and south in “South-sweet, north-salty, west-sour, and east-hot.”
The way we are using here is only the most famous one.
China is so big that trying all the Chinese cuisine would be a difficult task, but definitely an enjoyable one.
